name: epbc-tracker
description: Weekly diff of EPBC Act referrals. A pubdiff tracker.

scripts.enrich:weekly: pnpm run enrich-portal -- --bootstrap playwright --max-pages 10 --delay-ms 2000 && pnpm run merge-portal-enrichment
scripts.enrich:donations: pnpm run enrich-donations && pnpm run merge-donations && pnpm run build-site-data
scripts.scrape:collect: pnpm run fetch && pnpm run parse && pnpm run check-health && pnpm run index-update && pnpm run diff
scripts.scrape:render: pnpm run feed && pnpm run build-site-data
scripts.scrape: pnpm run scrape:collect && pnpm run scrape:render
scripts.scrape:full: pnpm run scrape && pnpm run post
